## Self-review checklist

- [ ] Does only what the task says
- [ ] Types complete, no dead code, no commented-out code, no TODO without an issue link
- [ ] Errors handled, no secrets, config via env
- [ ] Tests added or updated, including at least one failure case
- [ ] Untrusted content boundaries kept (if LLM-related: invoice/email/tool text never in system prompts)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/status.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, ADR if architectural)
- [ ] I can explain every line
